mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms.user_settings (user_id, setting_key, setting_value) VALUES (#{userId}, #{settingKey}, #{settingValue}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value = EXCLUDED.setting_value, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT setting_id as settingId, user_id as userId, setting_key as settingKey, setting_value as settingValue, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM cms.user_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND setting_key = #{settingKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cms.user_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND setting_key = #{settingKey}
